description:
## Goal

Prove that a real App unmount while both StrictMode listener lifecycles still have pending registrations cannot leave listeners active or dispatch startup later.

**Triage:** ready-for-agent

## Background

StrictMode cleanup 1 happens during the development probe cycle, but users can also cause a real cleanup by closing/remounting the renderer. `src/App.tsx:270-274` marks the current lifecycle disposed and calls handles already received. If a `listen()` promise has not resolved yet, the unlisten handle is unavailable during cleanup. The post-await checks at `src/App.tsx:199-203` and `211-215` are responsible for immediately removing those late handles when they arrive.

The App registers transition before refresh in each lifecycle, so after unmount and late resolution of `T1`/`T2`, the disposed asynchronous functions will still request `R1`/`R2`; those refresh handles must also unlisten on arrival. Neither lifecycle may reach startup.

This task uses the controlled listener harness from the focused App StrictMode suite.

## Work

1. Render the real App under `React.StrictMode`.
2. Wait until setup 1 and setup 2 have requested `T1` and `T2`.
3. Unmount before either transition promise resolves.
4. Resolve `T1` and `T2` through `act`; observe App request `R1` and `R2` from the now-disposed flows.
5. Resolve `R1` and `R2`.
6. Flush all queued continuations.

Assert:

- `T1`, `T2`, `R1`, and `R2` unlisten exactly once;
- no listener remains active;
- `loadIssueExplorerStateFromTauRpc()` is never called;
- TauRPC `workspace_state()` is never called;
- no React state-update-after-unmount warning appears;
- no unhandled rejection or unresolved test promise remains.

## Guardrails

- This is a real `unmount()` test, not another simulated cleanup assertion.
- Do not suppress warnings globally to make the test pass.
- Do not stop after transition handles; both sequential refresh registrations must be resolved and checked.
- No production changes are expected.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] App unmounts before pending registrations resolve.
- [ ] All four late registrations remove themselves exactly once.
- [ ] No startup Issue or Workspace read occurs.
- [ ] No listener, warning, or unhandled asynchronous work remains.
- [ ] Focused App lifecycle tests and `pnpm check` pass.
title: Test unmount while StrictMode listener registrations are pending
